_comment: Four synthetic warranty requests. 'form' is what the intake form captured. 'expected' is the decision the warranty terms give.

cases.message: The battery in my Nimbus laptop has swollen and the trackpad is lifting off the case.
The display on my Aura 8 purifier went dark yesterday, the fan still runs.
I dropped my Lumen X2 on a tile floor and the glass shattered. I have Care+.
The screen on my Strata 5 monitor has a dead pixel line.
